arguments.summary: APT-29 (Cozy Bear) conducted a multi-stage intrusion leveraging a spearphishing attachment delivered via a compromised partner email. Isolation of C2 channel and quarantine of compromised workstation initiated.
Persistence mechanism (scheduled task) removed from domain controller.
Ansible playbooks executed to harden all affected hosts and apply rollback steps.
Post‑remediation verification confirmed no further malicious activity.
